optimizedDescription.value: Central change entity governs lifecycle, approval gates, artifact and implementation state, history, drafts, and archival.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules
- Identity: immutable unique `name`, `createdAt`; `ActorIdentity` has `name`, `email`, optional `provider`, `providerId`, `metadata: Record<string, string>`. `updatedAt` defaults `createdAt`, never earlier; `touchUpdatedAt(at: Date = new Date())` advances it.
- Scope: mutable, empty-valid `specIds`; validate workspace at creation. `workspaces` runtime plural set via `parseSpecId()`, never persisted/primary or `workspaces[0]`. Scope change invalidates approvals; `updateSpecIds()` prunes absent `specDependsOn` keys. `specDependsOn` optional highest-priority `CompileContext` source, no invalidation; remaining metadata read dynamically/transitively.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`. `VALID_TRANSITIONS` authoritative; all except `drafting` may enter `designing`; `designing → designing` no invalidation/downgrade. Approval drain states remain historical-only: new `ready → implementing` and `done → archivable` stay source state until checks pass; gates `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default `false`.
- Retry: `done|signed-off|archivable → implementing|verifying` means retry, no mass artifact invalidation; invalidates active signoff only. `archiving` permits only `archivable|designing`; other targets throw `InvalidStateTransitionError`.
- `implementing → verifying` requires workflow task completion. `implementation-failure` returns implementation without artifact downgrade; artifact insufficiency or drift returns designing.
- Tracking: `trackedImplementationFiles` project-relative state `open|resolved|ignored|removed`; `removed` persists, reopens only refresh. `implementationLinks`: `spec → file → symbols`; preserve explicit file link when final symbol removed. Active paths project-relative; archive normalizes. Tracking activation is `implementationTrackingStartedAt`; `startImplementationTracking()` idempotent. Historical implementing signal immutable; entity detects nothing.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` has `type`, `optional`, ordered `requires`, persisted aggregate, `files`. `ArtifactFile`: `key`, `filename`, persisted state, `validatedHash`, `hasDrift`; states `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`. `pending-parent-artifact-review` verdict-only; legacy wire value coerces `in-progress`.
- Aggregate: drifted > pending > complete (all complete/skipped) > skipped (all skipped) > missing (none/all missing) > in-progress. Optional-only explicit skip; only `complete|skipped` satisfy requires. `markComplete(key, hash)` only `ValidateArtifacts`; `markSkipped()` only skip use case.
- Invalidation: `Change.invalidate()` needs cause/message/focused files/`artifactDag`; append `invalidated`, transition designing if needed. Policy `none|surgical|downstream|global`; override wins; downstream uses `artifactDag.descendantsOf()`, never persisted graph/private BFS. Drift applies focused files; review-required neither sets nor clears `hasDrift`.
- History append-only, state from latest `transitioned`; events include `created`, `transitioned`, approvals, `invalidated`, draft/restore, skip/sync, description, discard, `archive-failed`; each `type`, ISO `at`, `by`.
- Archive only from `archivable`. Failure records `step`, message, `commitStarted`; commit restore success returns archivable, failure stays archiving.
- Draft: move active to drafts, preserve lifecycle; drafted changes read-only except restore/discard. Discard requires reason/actor, optional `supersededBy`, irreversible. After tracking activation/historical implementation, draft/discard require force.

## Constraints
- History/state, explicit artifact state, and `hasDrift` authoritative; `validatedHash` baseline only.
- No primary workspace; approval gates opt-in; Change owns facts, `LifecycleEngine` owns DAG/effective status/check interpretation.
- Archive requires `archivable`; draft/discard safeguards mandatory.
